label: 🥇 Golden row assert
description: Assert that specific rows (matched by an ID column) still have the expected values in named target columns. Use to lock in the computed value of a small handful of canonical rows that exercise edge cases.

expectations.label: Expected rows JSON
expectations.help: JSON array of objects: [{"id": 42, "revenue": 1200, "is_premium": true}, …]. Each object MUST contain the ID column value plus the columns to assert.

tolerance.label: Numeric tolerance (absolute)
tolerance.help: Allowed absolute difference for float comparisons. 0 = exact match.
